items.html: But the general conclusion is that the beard of ZA, and also the Tefillin, all of them are surrounding lights coming out from the inwardness of ZA, and they are not like the surrounding lights of the Lamed-Mem of the Tzelem, which are before they entered within ZA at all. Rather, these surrounding lights are the inner lights themselves that returned and came out in the secret of surrounding lights. And understand this difference, as stated elsewhere.
